SpatialReference: n/a: no imaging is released; the columns lat/med/mid/olf/trans_coor are distances (mm) relative to orbitofrontal sulci as given by the authors, not image coordinates

brain_region.Description: release electrode label (e.g. ROFC = right orbitofrontal, LOFC = left orbitofrontal, OL/OD/LOD/ROD/RSFG/RSGC/LSFG as named by the authors; abbreviations not expanded)

lat_coor.Description: medial/lateral distance from the lateral orbital sulcus (release description)

med_coor.Description: release field med_coor (not defined in the release)

mid_coor.Description: release field mid_coor (not defined in the release)

olf_coor.Description: release field olf_coor (not defined in the release)

trans_coor.Description: release field trans_coor (not defined in the release)
